name: a choice written as a value binds the kept option's subtotal
a choice whose every option refuses refuses the rating, as a value too
an accumulated choice adds its subtotal each time
bill reads the lines billed so far
source:
tariff "t"
charge "Linehaul" = $1_000
let before = bill.total
charge "Fuel" as FSC = bill.freight * 10%
charge "Detention" as DET = $50
let line = bill.charge("Linehaul") ?? $0
note "{bill.freight} {bill.accessorials} {bill.total} {bill.charge(FSC) ?? $0} {line} {before}"
note "{bill.charge(LIFT) == none}"

name: inside an option, bill reads the bill outside the choice and the option's own lines
a nested option reads every bill around it
